commits.message: Add changelog generated from conventional commits
commits.body:
Replace the hardcoded roadmap section in the documentation with a dynamic
changelog that renders release notes from changelog.json. The changelog
entries are grouped by conventional commit type with color-coded tags,
commit SHA links, and version headers.

- Remove hardcoded ROADMAP data array and status-based rendering logic from
main.js
- Add dynamic changelog renderer that fetches and renders releases from
changelog.json
- Update i18n translations for the new changelog section (en + es)
- Update HTML nav link and section ID from "roadmap" to "changelog"
- Replace roadmap-specific CSS with changelog entry styles, tag classes,
and version headers

commits.message:
feat(template): add minimal handlebars-like template engine with HTML views

Introduce a server-side template engine supporting each-block loops,
HTML-escaped and raw scalar interpolation, and partial rendering.
Wire it into the router to serve dynamic HTML views.

- add template engine (shellrest/template.sh) with {{#each}}, {{key}},
  {{{key}}}, and {{.}} token support
- expose render_view and render_partial as the public rendering API
- add configurable VIEWS_DIR setting with sensible default
- add users list view (views/users_list.html) with per-row partial
- add GET /users/view HTML endpoint in the users route
- source template.sh from api.sh at startup

commits.message:
refactor(server): replace nc+FIFO with socat for request handling

Simplify the HTTP server loop by replacing the netcat + named pipe
approach with a single socat invocation.

- drop manual FIFO creation, trap cleanup, and while loop
- use socat with fork and reuseaddr for concurrent connection handling
- remove stale Spanish inline comments

commits.message:
refactor(db): return last insert row ID directly from db_insert

Make db_insert return the newly inserted row ID in a single SQL
execution instead of requiring a separate db_get_last_insert_id call.

- append SELECT last_insert_rowid() to db_insert query to return the
  generated ID atomically
- refactor post_users route to capture the ID directly from db_insert
  result, removing the extra db_get_last_insert_id invocation
- replace dd with head -c in api.sh body reader for simpler HTTP body
  extraction

fix(routes): remove redundant framework sourcing in route files

calling load_routes(), so each route file re-sourcing them parsed
and executed the framework twice per request.
